title: 生态与资源保护词汇
goal: 辨认生态与资源保护词汇，准确表达环保措施与目标。

points.label: 辨认生态与资源保护词汇
选择准确表达环保措施与目标的词语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 生态类材料常写四种措施：保护现有环境、恢复受损环境、减少污染、回收材料。措施的含义要看动词和它的对象。

body.box:
居民保护河岸植被，并回收废纸。
Residents protect riverside vegetation and recycle waste paper.

body.p: protect 的对象是植被，recycle 的对象是废纸。回收废纸和恢复植被是两件事。

body.box:
村庄在河岸种植本地植物，恢复受损的植被。居民还分类回收纸张，以减少送往处理场的废物。这两项措施分别针对河岸环境和家庭废物。
The village grows native plants along the riverbank to restore damaged vegetation. Residents also sort and recycle paper to reduce waste sent for disposal. The two measures address the riverbank and household waste respectively.

body.p: restore 的对象是受损植被，sort and recycle 的对象是纸张。reduce 指减少送往处理场的废物。

body.box:
What is being restored?
1. Recycled paper
2. Damaged vegetation
3. Household waste
4. The disposal site

body.p: 第二项对应 restore damaged vegetation。

groups.fill: A town sorts household waste for recycling. Residents place pa{per} in a separate b{in}, a rigid container, while gl{ass} bottles go into another cont{ainer}. The collection ser{vice} takes both mate{rials} to a recy{cling} facility. The facility proc{esses} both materials. Sorting keeps the paper and glass separate before processing. The town also encourages residents to re{use} containers and red{uce} unnecessary packaging. These actions concern different stages of waste management; collection alone does not mean that every item has already been recycled.
notes: materials：指纸张和玻璃两种材料。

groups.text:
A Stream Project

A village planted native grasses beside a stream to restore damaged banks. It also installed a filter to remove some material from wastewater before discharge. Volunteers collect discarded bottles for recycling. The planting, filtering and collection have different targets.

items.why: planted native grasses beside a stream 指明种植对象和地点。

items.stem: What is the filter used for?
items.why: a filter to remove some material from wastewater 指明过滤作用。

options: Sort used bottles for collection and later recycling
Return damaged banks toward a healthy state
Remove material from the stream banks
items.why: restore damaged banks 表示使受损河岸恢复。
Volunteers collect discarded bottles for recycling 指明收集对象。

options: Water that needs treatment before discharge
Stream water running along the restored banks
Material removed from water by the filter
items.why: filter ... from wastewater before discharge 说明废水在排放前处理。

groups.fill: Residents started a neighborhood waste project. The pro{ject} asks house{holds} to sort pa{per} sheets, gl{ass} and me{tal} into separate bi{ns}. A colle{ction} vehicle carries these mate{rials} to a recy{cling} facility. The facility processes each material separately after the collection vehicle arrives at the site. Residents can also reduce waste by reusing conta{iners}. The project records the amount collected, but this figure alone does not show how much material has been processed successfully.

groups.text:
Restoring a Wetland

A community is working to restore a wetland where part of the vegetation was damaged. Workers remove discarded material from the site and plant native grasses in areas where the original vegetation has disappeared. The goal of planting is to help vegetation return, not to turn the wetland into farmland. Some intact areas are protected from disturbance while the work takes place.

The project also seeks to reduce pollution entering the wetland. A nearby facility treats wastewater before releasing it, and staff monitor the water at a sampling point. The report describes these actions but does not claim that the water contains no contaminants. Treatment and monitoring are distinct: one acts on the wastewater, and the other gathers information about water quality.

Residents sort paper collected during the cleanup for recycling. Recycling concerns the discarded paper, while planting concerns the damaged vegetation. The report records how much paper was collected and where grasses were planted. It does not claim that the entire wetland has recovered. Subsequent observations can help the community assess changes in the restored areas.

中文信息：社区种植本地草恢复受损湿地植被，并保护未受损区域。附近设施处理废水，工作人员监测水质。清理出的纸张分类后回收，报告没有声称整个湿地已经恢复。

items.stem: What is the planting intended to restore?
items.why: plant native grasses ... help vegetation return 指明目标。

items.stem: What is done to intact areas?
options: They are used to store wastewater.
They are cleared for discarded paper.
items.why: Some intact areas are protected from disturbance 指明保护措施。

items.stem: What does treat mean in relation to wastewater?
options: Process it before it is released
Plant grasses in it before release
Collect paper from it for recycling
items.why: facility treats wastewater before releasing it 表示排放前处理废水。

items.stem: What does monitoring water quality do?
options: It guarantees that all contaminants disappear.
It replaces the planting of native grasses.
It recycles all material found at the site.
It gathers information about water quality.
items.why: monitoring ... gathers information about water quality 指明监测的作用。

items.stem: What does recycle refer to in the report?
options: Observing water at a sampling point
items.why: sort paper ... for recycling 指分类纸张以便回收利用。
